name: PayPal
summary:
PayPal is the checkout service at paypal.com. The overlapping-P mark in the tab is what payment bookmarks use, and the bytes below are the ones that host returned.

Checked 12 November 2026 against paypal.com. HTML came from https://www.paypal.com/us/home (HTTP 403). No icon link tags were readable in the HTML. Files below came from a manifest or from a path that returned an image.

The favicon.ico URL is https://www.paypal.com/favicon.ico. The saved file favicon.ico is 5430 bytes. Directory sizes: 32×32, 16×16.

No apple-touch-icon URL was declared, and the well-known apple-touch-icon.png path did not return an image.

No brand colour could be derived. The page had no theme-color, mask-icon colour, or manifest theme_color, and a dominant pixel colour was not readable from the saved PNGs.

The only measured sizes are inside favicon.ico: 32×32, 16×16.
